issues.where: crop K, sunlit upper globe toward the right limb
issues.what: Fine crater rims and bright surface markings smear diagonally into elongated flecks, while the nearby midface retains much crisper relief.
issues.fix: Use higher-resolution surface maps and anisotropic sampling at grazing angles; reduce any directional blur that erases crater detail.

issues.where: crops B and F, upper-left terminator
issues.what: Bright crater rims break into jagged white and orange hooks against soft, nearly featureless shadows, making the relief look embossed.
issues.fix: Soften the steepest micro-normal slopes, temper the rim highlights and supersample the subpixel ridges.

issues.where: crops M and N, solar disc and adjacent corona
issues.what: Large white patches on the disc lose the granular detail, and the white limb reads as a hard cutout against the diffuse gold corona. The same loss is visible in image-07.png crop L.
issues.fix: Roll off solar highlights without clipping the surface texture, and let the inner corona blend continuously into the bright limb.

issues.where: crop E, right-hand globe silhouette beneath the Sun
issues.what: A thin, nearly uniform pale line and a softer amber fringe trace the rocky edge separately, giving it a doubled outline.
issues.fix: Keep the lit terrain edge sharp and apply one exposure-driven bloom falloff rather than a second contour.

issues.where: crop D, just beyond the dark lower-left limb
issues.what: An isolated cream-and-red blur reads as a stray object among the pinpoint stars, with faint flare ghosts extending onto the dark globe.
issues.fix: Reduce the flare ghost's opacity and color separation so it stays subordinate to the starfield and silhouette.

issues.where: inside the large shadowed crater, centre right (about x 750, y 410 and x 890, y 385; crops A and Q)
issues.what: two small bright pale shapes float in the black shadow of the crater. They look like stray objects or leftover debris from generation, not lit terrain
issues.fix: remove the specks or paint the shadowed floor as plain unlit regolith

issues.where: east wall of the large crater, right half (crops E, F, R, W)
issues.what: the wall terraces are drawn as smooth swirling streaks of the same width, like brush strokes running round the bowl. They read as painted or airbrushed, not as slumped rock
issues.fix: break up the terraces with irregular slump blocks, scree and small impacts, and vary their spacing and width

issues.where: solar disc, upper right (crops C, L, K)
issues.what: the Sun is a flat, blown-out cream disc with soft blotches and no granulation or limb darkening. At native size it looks smeared and plastic
issues.fix: add fine granulation and limb darkening, and pull the exposure down so the disc keeps some texture

issues.where: corona below and right of the solar disc (crops M, Q, R)
issues.what: the corona streamers are smoky, smeared wisps that look like a soft brush pass, and they blur into a muddy brown haze over the stars
issues.fix: render the streamers as thin, sharp radial filaments that fade cleanly into black

issues.where: bright ray crater, upper left centre (crop B, K)
issues.what: the ray splash looks like a starburst sprite pasted onto the surface. The rays are thin and the same length, with a hard white centre
issues.fix: make the rays different lengths, let them fade unevenly, and follow the shape of the ground they cross

issues.where: middle and foreground plains (crops O, U, X)
issues.what: white and blue glints are scattered over the regolith like stars sitting on the ground, and some are coloured
issues.fix: drop the glints or keep them as faint neutral highlights on crater rims only

issues.where: middle distance and near the horizon (crops B, J, K, I)
issues.what: the surface goes soft and smooth towards the horizon, which looks more like blur than haze from distance, so mid-scale crater detail is lost
issues.fix: keep crater detail sharper towards the limb, letting it shrink with distance instead of blurring

issues.where: planet surface in the dim part next to the terminator (crops B, H)
issues.what: the craters go soft and slightly smeared where the light falls off, and the blue-white patches look painted on, not like real differences in the rock
issues.fix: keep the craters sharp through the falloff and tie the colour changes to crater rays and the shapes of the ground

issues.where: night side of the globe (crops D, N, T)
issues.what: the dark hemisphere is a completely flat black with no gradient and no earthshine-style detail, so it looks like a cut-out
issues.fix: add a very faint gradient and a hint of the surface on the night side
